# TopoXY

> Coordinate converter for surveyors on iPhone and Android, by Visto Apps (https://vistoapps.com).

TopoXY converts coordinates between GPS (WGS 84) and six national grids: Romania (Stereo 70, EPSG:3844), Poland (PUWG 1992), Czechia and Slovakia (S-JTSK Křovák), Italy (Gauss-Boaga) and Germany (ETRS89 / UTM). It measures distance, bearing, area and perimeter, imports points from text files, shows points on a map and estimates slope from terrain data. Conversions run on the phone without signal or account. Stated accuracy: about 3 m for Romania, about 1 m for Poland, Czechia, Slovakia and Germany, about 4 m for Italy (standard EPSG transformations without correction grids).

Free to download with ads; TopoXY Pro (weekly or monthly subscription, lifetime on iOS) unlocks conversions, measurements, import and slope tools and removes ads.
